nodes.label: After encountering or being involved in a crash, stop in a safe, lit public location without blocking traffic when possible.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning crash stop should be safe and unobstructive; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Provide needed or requested help to an injured person and immediately call nine one one after a crash.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning help and call emergency services; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Use hazard flashers and available flares to warn other drivers at a crash.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning warn approaching traffic; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Collect involved persons’ names, addresses, telephone numbers, license numbers and plate numbers.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning exchange identifying and vehicle information; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: The minor-violation ticket gives the court date; nonpayment or absence can lead to another date at least thirty days later and a clerk’s notice through the available contact system.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning ticket date may lead to second hearing; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Missing the second court date results in a conviction entered without the driver present and reported to the licensing agency like other convictions.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning second absence can become conviction; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: The handbook says failure-to-appear suspensions imposed from January first, two thousand twenty through December thirty-first, two thousand twenty-four are cleared.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning historic failure-to-appear period has stated relief; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: For a failure-to-appear suspension imposed before January first, two thousand twenty, the handbook requires court resolution of the ticket and payment of a reinstatement fee before the suspension ends.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning earlier suspension needs ticket resolution and fee; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A required court appearance by someone younger than eighteen must include a parent or guardian.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning minor court appearance includes guardian; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: For a ticket in another compact-member state, an Illinois driver may contest it there, pay it or promise compliance and handle it from home; breaking that promise may suspend the Illinois license.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning out-of-state ticket still requires compliance; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A crash involving death, injury or property damage above fifteen hundred dollars requires a report regardless of who caused it.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning serious crash reporting does not depend on fault; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: If any involved vehicle lacks insurance, property damage exceeding five hundred dollars requires a crash report.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning uninsured vehicle lowers stated damage threshold; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A crash involving a school bus requires a report for property damage or personal injury.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning school-bus crash reporting has broad triggers; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A crash within fifty feet of a school bus must be reported when it injures or kills someone waiting to board or someone who has just left the bus.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning near-bus boarding injury requires report; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Notify police immediately after a crash and make the report within thirty minutes; if no officer attends, report at the nearest police station promptly, or notify the sheriff or state police in a rural area.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning immediate notice and prompt official report; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: When the driver cannot report a crash and a passenger is present, the passenger must make the report.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning unable driver shifts reporting duty to passenger; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Failure to report a vehicle crash can bring a fine up to twenty-five hundred dollars and imprisonment up to one year.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning nonreporting can carry fine and jail; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Leaving a crash scene can result in criminal charges; an injury or fatality requires license revocation, while damage above one thousand dollars brings suspension.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning leaving scene can withdraw driving privileges; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: After damaging an unattended vehicle or other property, stop clear of traffic and, if the owner cannot be found, leave your name, address, telephone number and plate number.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning unattended damage requires identifying note; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A crash damaging unattended property still requires notifying police and completing required crash reports.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning leaving a note does not replace reporting; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: An uninsured driver responsible for a crash causing injury, death or damage must post security to cover the injured party’s damages, with the state transportation department determining its amount.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning uninsured at-fault crash can require security; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Failing to post required crash security can suspend the driver’s license until the lawsuit is settled and can also suspend the vehicle owner’s registration or plates.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning missing security can affect driver and owner; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: The stated driver or registration suspension continues until financial-responsibility proof is supplied and insurance is maintained for three years from the first filing.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning responsibility filing includes continued insurance; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A mandatory-insurance conviction brings at least three months of lost driving privileges, a one-hundred-dollar reinstatement fee and no driving permit.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning mandatory-insurance conviction has no permit relief; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Financial-responsibility proof is required for an unpaid crash judgment, an uninsured-crash safety-responsibility suspension, insurance-violation court supervision or at least three mandatory-insurance convictions.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning listed insurance or judgment history triggers proof; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Proof may take the form of an insurance certificate, bond or deposited securities, and the insurer files the required certificate directly with the agency.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning financial-responsibility proof has stated forms; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: The agency monitors required insurance, and cancellation or failure to renew results in license suspension.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning maintain monitored insurance coverage; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A driver aged fifty-five or older may qualify for a liability-insurance reduction after an eight-hour defensive-driving course and should ask the insurer about the reduction amount.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning older-driver course may reduce insurance cost; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.
